goal: Access recertification: periodic review that each person still needs each access.
use: Access recertification: periodic review that each person still needs each access. Use when an access review cycle is due.

steps.note: List the accounts and roles with their owners.
Check the need. Each owner confirms the access is still needed.
Remove the stale. Revoke access that is not confirmed in the period.
Check service accounts. Each has an owner and a purpose.
Report. The accesses reviewed, revoked and still open, with the owners.
